title: I quit.
content:
Hi everyone, me developer.


Recently, I’ve found myself with very little to do, as the server has become quite inactive. Given the current situation, I feel it’s no longer necessary for me to continue working on its development.


For now, I’ll be stepping away and taking an unexpected break from all work related to this server. I kindly ask that you do not contact me regarding any further matters.


Thank you for your understanding.
